title: Cross-lot analysis
subtitle: Choose the lots to compare, then read yield and spread

pick.title: Lots compared
pick.empty: No lots match — widen the filters.

trend.title: Yield trend
trend.desc: One point per lot, placed on its test date and coloured by verdict
trend.tooFew: Pick at least two lots to see a trend.
trend.noTestDate: {{count}} lots carry no test date and sit on their upload time (ringed on the chart)
trend.mixedProducts: {{count}} different products selected — their yields are not comparable

box.title: Parameter spread
box.desc: One box per lot on a shared scale; dashed red lines are the spec limits
box.empty: No measurements for this parameter in the selected lots.

hint.title: What this page shows
lines: Tick the lots you want to compare — across products and across periods.
The trend says which lot moved; the boxes say how — a lot with a healthy yield but a shifted distribution only shows up below.
— The time axis is the test date from the CP file, not the upload time; a * after a lot means its file carried none
— To look inside a single lot, use Analytics & AI

spc.title: SPC control chart
spc.desc: One point per wafer in test order; limits derived from the data, not from a yield target
spc.tooFew: Pick a parameter and at least two wafers to draw a control chart.
